prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical mirror selfie of an approved adult demonstrating a full split stretch indoors, preserving the green lace-trim camisole, blue leggings, mirror, and warm room.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair, calm confident expression, wearing a green lace-trim camisole and high-stretch blue leggings. Keep the pose athletic and natural with realistic anatomy.
prompt.composition_elements: The subject performs a full split on a polished dark wood floor while taking a mirror selfie. Include beige walls, ceiling fan with light, window with blinds, wall outlets, and large framed mirror. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm ceiling light with soft indoor shadows, realistic floor reflections, calm flexibility-practice atmosphere and natural skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, vertical 9:16, high-angle or eye-level mirror perspective, accurate reflection and anatomy, realistic fabric detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair and a calm confident expression, performing a full split stretch on a polished dark wood floor. She wears a green lace-trim camisole and high-stretch blue leggings. Beige walls, ceiling fan with light, window with blinds, wall outlets, and large framed mirror. Warm ceiling light, soft shadows, realistic floor reflection, accurate anatomy and mirror synchronization, elegant athletic lifestyle mood.
